text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa finishes 1st!
It's Nakayama Festa—!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ha... Damn it... Damn it all...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Damn, she's strong...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...She's completely wiped out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course...!
I ran so I wouldn't lose to you, y'know...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's only my second graded race...!
*gasp*... *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Don't cry.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not crying!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna get stronger...
way, way stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become such an amazingly strong Umamusume that not even you, my classmate, will leave me behind...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Stay alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Please stay alive.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Today's GIII was even more thrilling to watch than usual.
Wait, huh...!? That Umamusume just now was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice too?!
I knew it, right?! The one who just passed by wasâ

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...The time has come!!
Here we go, flying high, Mambo-o-o!!"

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah!
(Flutter-flutter...!)

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—Just as a bird resting on a branch
will one day take flight into the vast sky."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "You, too, shall surely soar through the skies toward a grand goal."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: “Tearing through the sky, with the setting sun at my back, effortlessly leaping over the boundary between today and tomorrow.”

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"‘Leaping across the twinkling stars.
Now welcoming the radiant morning sun with those wings.’"

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Because it flies away so beautifully,
I can't help but gaze up at the sky too."

text_block_list.name: Letter from Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "With shining eyes, wanting to fly through the sky just like you... wanting to live."

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure you have no end of things you want to say, but how about putting down the pen for now?

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: Isn't it about time she arrived?
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Look.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling, Sensei?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you, I've decided to go through with the surgery."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Because even if the chances are infinitely low,
I held on to the hope of seeing you race once more."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: “Wishing to live”... you say?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei. Could it be...
ever since the 'Kikka Sho', you've—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...I had... surgery.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a miracle.
Even when told to focus on palliative care, my daughter kept pushing back, until finally—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't bring myself to give up.
It's your... win, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Telling you... so late...
...I'm sorry.

Though her voice was raspy,
it possessed an unmistakable, unwavering core.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's fine. Sensei.
Sensei...—!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank... you.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Why don't we step outside?
Just for five minutes while we grab some drinks.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, would you prefer
something hot to drink, or something cold?
choice_data_list: Oh, please don't worry about my share.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
Please, do not hesitate.
This is far from enough to repay you, considering how grateful I am to all of you.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: I cannot tell you how many times your presence has encouraged my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"That is why a miracle happened this time.
I truly believe it was a miraculous event.
However... ........."

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...The fact remains that anything could happen
to my daughter at any moment."

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: Even though the immediate danger has passed, it wouldn't be surprising if her health took a turn for the worse again tomorrow. That's just how severe an illness it was.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: She has terrifyingly sharp intuition. She'll notice right away.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: "However, no matter what happens to our daughter from here on out, you must not blame yourselves."

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
For now... I would be grateful if you could just celebrate the hope my daughter has found.
...Please take good care of her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: And then, watching the Chunichi Shimbun Hai too... It made me think that no matter what... I was going to live...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... If that happens, it'll be another year.
Even after a year passes... I'll still be right here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Just stubbornness, huh?
Heh heh, spoken just like you, Sensei.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Really... okay?
I'll even come to Paris... to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Then,
this time it's not a bet, but a promise. Sensei."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'm heading to Paris... and yeah, I'll even enter the Takarazuka Kinen that Sensei loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Perhaps in the season slightly after
the violets are in bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. So keep your eyes
glued on me, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: First, picturing myself taking 1st place in the Takarazuka Kinen.
